project_provenance.remediation: Binding real per-project commit/tree ids requires authorized access to those repositories, which is outside this task's boundary. Until then these fields stay null with provenance_status UNKNOWN, which is the honest state rather than a filled-in guess.
project_provenance.not_claimed_correction: Audit F01's wording says the archive is not a 'three-repo cloud full tree' nor 'all GPT history'. So that half of F01 does not describe any assertion the package actually makes, and is recorded here rather than silently accepted.
